about: The `series_school_personnel_changes` table, published whole. See /api/schema for its grain. This file is edition 2000 only.

rows.quote: Mr. Anthony Falcone, Mr. Richard Kullman, and Mr. Robert Saudelli have announced their plans to retire at the end of the current school year. They have served thirty-three, thirty-four, and thirty-seven years respectively.
rows.note: Superintendent's report; years spelled out, in the order the names are printed.
